sectionGuidance.story coverage rules: Define which shared components require stories, required story states, and minimum controls/args for design review.
sectionGuidance.OpenPencil feedback capture: Explain how OpenPencil comments or design feedback are captured, linked to tasks, and resolved before UI close-out.
sectionGuidance.component acceptance handoff: State what evidence proves a component is accepted, including story URL, visual state, accessibility notes, and linked task/node references.

sectionGuidance.visual review scope: Define which UI changes require visual review, screenshot/video evidence, and whether review happens in Storybook, app preview, or both.
sectionGuidance.component story smoke: Describe the minimal Storybook smoke check required after shared component or design-token changes.

implementation.summary: Component Policy current before shared UI/component changes

verification.summary: Design QA Checklist or Test Run Report includes Storybook/OpenPencil evidence for changed shared UI
